protocol.injection: a = 1 + sigma_a * z, corr(z, ys)=r exact, std(z)=1; Xi = a[:,None]*X0
protocol.estimator: Alpha/Beta from estimate_physical_params on the uninjected data
protocol.caveat: alpha/beta are estimated once per dataset from the uninjected spectra; the analytic curve is therefore a theory prediction, not a fit to the injected grid
